instagram.body:
Our first-ever productivity challenge is live on YouTube: The CODE Challenge.

We gave three Second Brainers 30 days to put the CODE method under real pressure. Three different tools. Three projects with hard deadlines. One shared system: Capture, Organize, Distill, Express.

Episode 1 sets up the series. The next four episodes go deep on each step: Capture, Organize, Distill, Express.

instagram.author: iamrobinvv
instagram.body:
I let AI plan my entire week and my productivity tripled.

Every Sunday night I used to sit down with a notebook and try to plan my week. Never worked. By Tuesday everything was off track.

Then I started telling Claude everything. My goals. My deadlines. My energy levels. My meetings.

It builds my schedule now. It knows I do creative work best in the morning. It blocks focus time. It fits in calls when my energy dips.

Last week I finished everything on my list for the first time in years.

#AI #ClaudeCode #Productivity #AIautomation #TimeManagement
